_rule: One version per result set. Every number in this repository belongs to exactly the versions below; nothing is pinned, and nothing moves on its own. `python3 scripts/versions.py --check` says what is newer upstream; `python3 scripts/versions.py --latest <engine>` moves one engine to its newest release, after which every recorded unit of that engine is superseded and the runners measure them all again (pass --accept-version-change). The maintainer's rule, 2026-09-12: knowledge/decisions/engine-versions-one-per-result-set.md.

mysql.named_by: the official image mysql:9.7.2, by digest

doltlite.named_by: the SHA-256 of the release's two Debian packages, checked before the image is built

sqlite.named_by: built from sqlite.org's sqlite-autoconf-3530400.tar.gz (sha3-256 verified against its download page) into the DoltLite image
